hooks.name: Diagnosis tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the engine's unit, property and case tests whenever an engine file, its tests or a case file is saved.

hooks.name: Data dictionary on field-registry save
hooks.description: Regenerates the generated table in docs/medical-data-dictionary.md after src/domain/schema/fields.ts changes, so docs never drift from the registry.

hooks.name: Guideline guard before engine tasks
hooks.description: Before a spec task runs, reminds the agent of the sourcing and ownership rules for clinical thresholds.

action.prompt: Before implementing: (1) every threshold you add or change must have an R-DX-* rule id, a DOI in src/domain/diagnosis/sources.ts and a status row in docs/research/diagnosis-engine.md; never change a threshold to make a test pass. (2) Only edit the owner's folders listed in .kiro/steering/product.md; ask before touching shared files. (3) Add boundary unit tests on both sides of every threshold.

hooks.name: Full check before finishing
hooks.description: When the agent stops, runs the same checks CONTRIBUTING.md requires before a push (a push to main deploys to production).

action.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
